mapper.select:
select t.*,
df.id as "df_id", dfs.id as "df_resources_id", dfs.file_name as "df_fileName", dfs.extension as "df_extension", dfs.size as "df_size", dfs.content_type as "df_contentType", df.expiration_date as "df_expirationDate", df.description as "df_description", df.type as "df_type", df.status as "df_status",
df.drivers_license as "df_driversLicense", dfst.id as "df_stateId", dfst.name as "df_stateName", dfc.id as "df_countryId", dfc.name as "df_countryName", df.class_type as "df_classType", df.issued_date as "df_issuedDate", df.last_collected_on as "df_lastCollectedOn", df.social_security_number as "df_socialSecurityNumber",
endor.id as "df_en_id", endor.name as "df_en_name" from ( select di.id as "id", di.first_name as "firstName", di.last_name as "lastName", di.middle_name as "middleName", di.hire_date as "hireDate", di.termination_date as "terminationDate", di.termination_reason as "terminationReason", di.date_of_birth as "dateOfBirth", di.address as "address", di.city as "city", di.zip_code as "zipCode", di.email as "email", di.phone as "phone", di.status as "status", di.type as "type",
s.id as "stateId", s.name as "stateName", c.id as "countryId", c.name as "countryName",
tr.id as "truckId", tr.unit || ' ' || tr.vin as "truckName",
tra.id as "trailerId", tra.unit || ' ' || tra.vin as "trailerName",
com.id as "companyId", com.name as "companyName",
u.id as "createdById", u.name as "createdByName",
di.created as "created" from drivers di left join states s on s.id = di.state_id left join countries c on c.id = s.country_id left join trucks tr on tr.driver_id = di.id left join trailers tra on tra.driver_id = di.id left join companies com on com.id = di.company_id left join users u on u.id = di.created_by_id where 1=1
and di.company_id = ${companyId}
and (di.first_name like '%${driverName}%' or di.last_name like '%${driverName}%' or di.middle_name like '%${driverName}%')
and di.status = '${status}'
limit ${rowsPerPage} offset ${page-1} * ${rowsPerPage}
) t left join driver_files df on df.driver_id = t.id and df.status = 'ACTIVE' left join states dfst on dfst.id = df.state_id left join countries dfc on dfc.id = dfst.country_id left join driver_files_endorsement dfe on dfe.driver_file_entity_id = df.id left join endorsements endor on endor.id = dfe.endorsement_id left join resources dfs on dfs.id = df.resource_id
